search_text: published ZDI-07-004 ZDI-CAN-130 CA BrightStor ARCserve Backup Tape Engine Buffer Overflow Vulnerability 2007-01-11 CVE-2007-0169 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-0169 ['Computer Associates'] ['BrightStor ARCserve Server'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Computer Associates BrightStor ARCserve Backup. User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists in the Tape Engine RPC service which listens by default on TCP port 6503 with the following UUID: 2b93df0-8b02-11ce-876c-00805f842837 The service exposes a buffer overflow in the handler for RPC opnum 0xCF that allows for arbitrary code execution when handling user-supplied data from the RPC request. Computer Associates has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
